`FHIRResource` is imported from `@openmrs/esm-framework` in three places in openmrs-esm-patient-chart. I didn't open `FHIRResource`'s definition in openmrs-esm-core, so I don't know which of its fields these usages depend on. The line numbers below come from a text search and aren't checked against the full files. I didn't read the form-data-source service beyond the matched lines.

1. **Vitals types** (`esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/types.ts`, line 1 import, line 6 use): `entry: Array<FHIRResource>` is the response type used for vitals and notes data. A change to the shape of `FHIRResource` would flow through this type.
2. **Vitals data resource** (`esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts`, line 3 import, line 561 use): `extractEncounterUuid(encounter: FHIRResource['resource']['encounter'])` depends on the type's `resource.encounter` field. It is called at lines 345 and 513. The code that reads `entry.resource` at lines 310–311 and 341–342 is also exposed to a change.
3. **Form-entry data source** (`esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-data-source/form-data-source.service.ts`, line 6 import, lines 227–230 use): `openmrsFetch<{ entry: Array<FHIRResource> }>` and the following `.then` handler use the type for a FHIR fetch.

Related: `esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts` (around line 41) declares its own `FHIRResource` interface as a mock. It would need to be kept in step with any change to the real type.
